subject: pathology
title: Regenerative Nodules, Portal Hypertension, Encephalopathy, Hepatorenal and Budd-Chiari Syndromes

steps.tx: Regenerative nodules are hepatocyte islands proliferating within fibrous septa, their disorganised plates and distorted vessels defining cirrhosis microscopically beside clinical portal hypertension. Reticulin stain outlines plates two or three cells thick inside each **regenerative nodule**, contrasting with the collapsed reticulin framework of a dysplastic focus, and that orderly though crowded growth is precisely what keeps the nodule benign despite its alarming size.
steps.say: Fibrous rings around regenerative nodules are cirrhosis under the microscope; architecture, not enzymes, names it.

steps.tx: Portal hypertension from increased intrahepatic resistance and splanchnic inflow opens collaterals at oesophagus, umbilicus, rectum, and retroperitoneum while spleen enlarges and ascites forms. A hepatic venous pressure gradient above 10 mm Hg marks clinically significant **portal hypertension**, and once it passes 12 mm Hg variceal bleeding becomes likely, numbers that explain why nonselective beta blockade aims to pull the gradient down before the first bleed.
steps.say: Varices, caput, splenomegaly, ascites: portal hypertension writes the same four signatures everywhere.

vis.caption: Portal hypertension collaterals across varices, spleen, and abdominal wall.

steps.tx: Hepatic encephalopathy clouds mentation from ammonia and inflammatory mediators bypassing or overwhelming failing hepatocytes, graded from subtle psychometric change through asterixis to coma, precipitants hunted first. **Asterixis** appears as an irregular flapping lapse when the wrists stay dorsiflexed, and finding it should trigger a search for gastrointestinal bleeding, infection, constipation or a new sedative rather than a reflex rise in ammonia lowering therapy alone.
steps.say: Encephalopathy means hunt infection, bleeding, constipation, and sedatives before blaming ammonia alone.

vis.caption: Hepatic encephalopathy pathophysiology from ammonia to cerebral dysfunction.

steps.tx: Hepatorenal syndrome constricts renal vessels functionally in advanced cirrhosis after albumin and vasoconstrictor exclusion of structural causes, kidneys histologically innocent yet failing by haemodynamics. Diagnosis now requires creatinine that fails to improve after two days of albumin challenge and diuretic withdrawal, with bland urine and no shock; terlipressin plus albumin can reverse **hepatorenal syndrome** in a substantial minority and bridge selected patients toward transplantation.
steps.say: Normal kidneys failing in cirrhosis by vasoconstriction: hepatorenal syndrome after albumin challenge excludes others.

vis.caption: Hepatorenal syndrome pathophysiology of splanchnic vasodilation and renal vasoconstriction.

steps.tx: Budd-Chiari syndrome thromboses hepatic veins or vena cava from myeloproliferative and thrombophilic states, congesting liver into painful hepatomegaly, ascites, and caudate hypertrophy sparing its direct drainage. The caudate lobe keeps its own vein opening straight into the vena cava, so it enlarges while the remaining liver congests; testing for a JAK2 positive myeloproliferative neoplasm belongs in every new **Budd-Chiari syndrome** workup even when blood counts look deceptively normal.
steps.say: Painful big liver, ascites, spared hypertrophied caudate: Budd-Chiari until hepatic veins are proven open.

steps.tx: Drug induced liver injury mimics every pattern in this lesson, hepatocellular, cholestatic, mixed, steatotic, or vanishing bile ducts, so medication and supplement excavation belongs in every liver workup. A hepatocellular injury with jaundice carries about a ten percent risk of death or transplantation under the observation called **Hy law**, and the culprit list must stretch back three months to capture herbal products, antitubercular drugs and antibiotics started long before enzymes rose.
steps.say: Herbals and supplements hide in liver histories; excavate them in every unexplained enzyme pattern.

steps.tx: Variceal bleeding management sequences resuscitation, vasoactive drugs, antibiotics, endoscopic banding, and rescue balloon or shunt strategies, transfusion restrained to avoid pressure rebound. Blood transfusion pauses around a haemoglobin of 7 g per decilitre because overfilling raises portal pressure and restarts bleeding, while ceftriaxone prophylaxis cuts bacterial infection that otherwise drives early **rebleeding** and death after the endoscope has secured the varix.
steps.say: Restrict transfusion, start vasoactives and antibiotics, band early: variceal bleeding protocol in one line.

steps.tx: Transplant assessment integrates MELD scoring, frailty, cardiopulmonary fitness, addiction sustained recovery, and hepatocellular carcinoma criteria, while palliative care parallels those not listed. The **MELD score** combines bilirubin, creatinine, INR and sodium to rank waiting list urgency, so a climbing sodium corrected score can move a patient upward even before any new decompensating event declares itself at the bedside.
steps.say: Assess for transplant and palliate in parallel; hope and honesty share the same clinic visit.
